strengths: Correctly identified canonical astrocyte core markers (Aqp4, Slc1a3, Aldoc, Atp1a2, Gja1)
Explicitly ruled out competing CNS lineages based on marker absence
Provided functional grouping of markers (glutamate transport, gap junctions, end-foot) consistent with astrocyte identity
Attempted subtype-level interpretation (perivascular/reactive) grounded in observed markers such as Cldn10, Agt, Gpld1, F3
weaknesses: Subtype proposal is not ontology-resolvable (unmapped CL term) and cannot be used for the final label
Reactive/disease-associated interpretation depends partly on experimental context rather than direct cluster-level evidence

strengths: Exact ontology-resolvable label with deterministic CL:0000127 mapping
Selected strong discriminative astrocyte markers (Aqp4, Slc1a3, Gja1, Cldn10, Fgfr3)
weaknesses: Terse reasoning without functional/pathway integration or explicit exclusion of other CNS lineages

strengths: Anchored on highly specific astrocyte markers with functional annotation (Aqp4 end-foot channel, Slc1a3 glutamate uptake, Gja1/Gjb6 gap junctions)
Correctly noted absence of competing neuronal/microglial/oligodendrocyte markers
Enrichment terms (astrocyte projection, astrocyte end-foot, L-glutamate transmembrane transport) directly support astrocyte biology
weaknesses: Many transport/ion terms are shared with other cell types and only support identity when combined with the marker set

supporting: Canonical astrocyte markers Aqp4, Slc1a3, Aldoc, Atp1a2, Gja1, Gjb6, Slc4a4, Agt, Fgfr3, Gpr37l1
Astrocyte-specific GO cellular components: astrocyte projection, astrocyte end-foot
L-glutamate transmembrane transport and amino acid transport enrichment consistent with astrocyte glutamate recycling
PMID 34065606 (allowed citation) supporting astrocyte identification in mouse CNS single-cell data
conflicting: No definitive neuronal, oligodendrocyte, microglial, or endothelial markers in the top DEG list to support an alternative lineage
enrichment_or_literature: Enrichment: astrocyte projection, astrocyte end-foot, acidic amino acid transport, L-glutamate transmembrane transport, gap junction assembly

provenance.note: Publication-facing final decision, QC disposition and evaluation fields are synchronized to the submitted Supplementary Data.
